"""Stream sorting utilities."""

def merge_stream(left: list[int], right: list[int]) -> list[int]:
    """Merge two pre-sorted lists into a single sorted list."""
    merged = []
    i = 0
    j = 0
    while i < len(left) and j < len(right):
        if left[i] <= right[j]:
            merged.append(left[i])
            i += 1
        else:
            merged.append(right[j])
            j += 1
    merged.extend(left[i:])
    merged.extend(right[j:])
    return merged

"""Token bucket rate limiter."""

import time

class RateLimiter:
    """Token bucket algorithm for rate-limiting requests."""

    def __init__(self, capacity: int, refill_rate: float) -> None:
        """Initialize bucket capacity and refill rate in tokens/sec."""
        self.capacity = capacity
        self.refill_rate = refill_rate
        self.tokens = float(capacity)
        self.last_refill = time.time()

    def consume(self, tokens_requested: int = 1) -> bool:
        """Attempt to consume tokens from bucket, replenishing if elapsed."""
        now = time.time()
        elapsed = now - self.last_refill
        self.tokens = min(float(self.capacity), self.tokens + elapsed * self.refill_rate)
        self.last_refill = now
        
        if self.tokens >= tokens_requested:
            self.tokens -= tokens_requested
            return True
        return False

"""Stateful event dispatcher."""

class Dispatcher:
    """Handles asynchronous message dispatching."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        """Initialize empty queue."""
        self.queue: list[dict] = []
        self.processed: set[str] = set()

    def dispatch(self, batch_size: int = 10) -> int:
        """Drain and dispatch pending queue events with idempotency check."""
        dispatched_count = 0
        while self.queue and dispatched_count < batch_size:
            item = self.queue.pop(0)
            msg_id = item.get("id", "")
            if msg_id and msg_id not in self.processed:
                self.processed.add(msg_id)
                dispatched_count += 1
        return dispatched_count

"""Worker pool synchronizer."""

import threading
from typing import Callable, Any

class WorkerPool:
    """Thread pool with synchronization locks."""

    def __init__(self, size: int = 4) -> None:
        """Initialize pool with thread locks."""
        self.size = size
        self.lock = threading.Lock()
        self.active_jobs = 0

    def execute_job(self, job_fn: Callable[[], Any]) -> Any:
        """Execute job under lock synchronization with deadlock prevention."""
        with self.lock:
            if self.active_jobs >= self.size:
                raise RuntimeError("Worker pool exhausted")
            self.active_jobs += 1
        try:
            return job_fn()
        finally:
            with self.lock:
                self.active_jobs -= 1
